text:
Rowan (People Ops): compact kit for midpoint check-ins + copyable items for ICs/managers. kept intentionally short so you can paste into 1:1s and calendar invites.
Leila (Eng Manager): love compact. can you give a single-sentence blurb for calendar invites?
Rowan (People Ops): calendar blurb (paste into event): 'Midpoint check-in — 20m: quick outcomes, blockers, and one support ask. Bring your 1-paragraph self-summary.'
Dave (SWE): thanks. can you also drop a 3-line self-summary ICs can paste into the review form?
Rowan (People Ops): sure — 3-line self-summary (copy/paste):
"""
Role & focus: [one line]
Top outcomes (with evidence): 1-2 bullets (links/metrics)
Ask & growth: one sentence (what you need & how you want to grow)
"""
Ellen (Design): any guidance for managers to score during calibration?
Rowan (People Ops): quick rubric snippet for calibration (one line each):
- Impact: high/med/low + 1-line evidence
- Ownership: high/med/low + 1-line evidence
- Growth potential: high/med/low + 1-line note
Leila (Eng Manager): can we add a peer feedback checkbox that is asynchronous?
Rowan (People Ops): async peer ask (single question + optional example):
Q: "What's one concrete thing this person did that helped you ship?" (1-2 bullets)
Optional example to show them: "Reviewed my PR and suggested a perf improvement that cut runtime 20% (PR #123)."
Dave (SWE): neat. any sample phrasing managers can use to request upward feedback?
Rowan (People Ops): manager upward note (one-liner to send to reports):
"I'd value 2 bullets: 1) one thing I should stop/start/continue; 2) one thing I can unblock for you in the next 2 weeks."
FeedbackBot: Tip: schedule midpoint reminders with `/feedback schedule --when midpoint-2w --team @teamname` or add to cycle template in /docs/perf/cycle.
Leila (Eng Manager): will add into our team's recurring invites. also, is there a short template for managers to capture 1:1 notes after the check-in?
Rowan (People Ops): 1:1 post-checkin note (3 fields):
- Outcome update (1 line)
- Decisions / help requested (1 line)
- Career pulse / next step (1 line)
Leila (Eng Manager): perfect. can you version these? we'll tweak for on-call rotation folks.
Rowan (People Ops): yes — version: v1.0. if you change, paste new version tag here so we can keep a canonical copy. thanks! :partyparrot:
Ellen (Design): adding to our team handbook now.
Rowan (People Ops): quick ask: if you localize wording for an IC who prefers bullets vs paragraphs, note that in the review as "format preference" so calibration reviewers know.
Leila (Eng Manager): good call. thanks everyone.
